?

a
∫π/2π∫05r2sin⁡θdrdθ
b
∫0π/2∫05r2sin⁡θdrdθ
c
∫0π∫05r3sin⁡(2θ)drdθ
d
∫0π/2∫05r3sin⁡(2θ)drdθ
e
∫0π/2∫05r3cos⁡θdrdθ
